name: tile-health-app

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:build-debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug

description: A pass-and-play multiplayer life counter for Commander (EDH) — one shared device, screen split into per-player zones (rotated for players sitting across the table), built with TypeScript + Vite and wrapped for Android via Capacitor. No backend, no network — everything runs locally on the device.
